convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'i-KlPrice' which is a custom indicator with non-standard parameters (two smoothing methods, deviation, custom applied price). Also depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh and TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade/money management logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timing
Value[0] and Value[1] - indicator buffer 1 values at SignalBar and SignalBar+1

other_exits: Buy close when i-KlPrice buffer 1 value[1] < 2 (discretionary level threshold)
Sell close when i-KlPrice buffer 1 value[1] > 2 (discretionary level threshold)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) is interpreted differently based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The i-KlPrice custom indicator outputs discrete integer values (0-4) in buffer 1 representing price levels relative to deviation bands. Entry signals use state transitions: BUY when value drops from 4 to below 4 (exiting overbought), SELL when value rises from 0 to above 0 (exiting oversold). Exit signals use threshold levels: close buy when value < 2, close sell when value > 2. Signal is evaluated on SignalBar (default=1, previous closed bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as feature toggles to enable/disable each signal type independently. The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of the i-KlPrice custom indicator which uses two smoothing passes (configurable via Smooth_Method enum including JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). The indicator applies: (1) first smoothing of price with MA_Method1/Length1/Phase1, (2) deviation bands calculation with Deviation parameter, (3) second smoothing with MA_Method2/Length2/Phase2, (4) quantization into 5 discrete levels (0-4) based on UpLevel/DnLevel thresholds. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must also be ported - it handles position open/close operations with money management (5 margin modes), deviation control, and global variable management. The discrete level-based signal system (0-4 states with threshold transitions) is the core logic and must be faithfully reproduced. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points - need to verify whether digit adjustment (x10 for 5-digit) is needed based on the broker's _Digits/_Point.
